current.changeLog:
Version 1.0.8 comes with reverted back turret and gun instant synchronization with responsive reticle movement (it was removed for optimisations).

It has been given back at the cost of 25 microseconds (negligible cost), but now gun model exactly follows responsive reticle.
User requested to revert it back and I find it a valid exception of optimisation rule.
Also comes with small change, that slows down tick-rate when there are no reticles present (for example: during artillery strike in Onslaught)
